snippet.title: FableBrawl — Early Access Gameplay (Official)
snippet.description:
FableBrawl is a browser-based high-fantasy auto-battler. This one-minute gameplay demo shows hero selection, recruiting from the shop, rerolling, formation, and automatic tactical brawls.

Play: https://www.fablebrawl.com/
Discord: https://discord.gg/j52qC8cts
